#define DSL(debug_bit, id, ...)					\ /* <=== bin/varnishd/cache/cache.h:1136:1140:DSL:3 */ 
	do {							\
		if (DO_DEBUG(debug_bit))			\
			VSL(SLT_Debug, (id), __VA_ARGS__);	\
	} while (0)
void Lck__Lock(struct lock *lck, const char *p,  int l); /* <=== Lck__Lock */

#define TIMESTAMP()						\ /* <=== lib/libvarnish/vtim.c:221:231:TIMESTAMP:0 */ 
	do {							\
		DIGIT(10, hour);				\
		DIGIT(1, hour);					\
		MUSTBE(':');					\
		DIGIT(10, min);					\
		DIGIT(1, min);					\
		MUSTBE(':');					\
		DIGIT(10, sec);					\
		DIGIT(1, sec);					\
	} while(0)

#define	VTAILQ_INSERT_TAIL(head, elm, field) do {			\ /* <=== include/vqueue.h:530:535:VTAILQ_INSERT_TAIL:3 */ 
	VTAILQ_NEXT((elm), field) = NULL;				\
	(elm)->field.vtqe_prev = (head)->vtqh_last;			\
	*(head)->vtqh_last = (elm);					\
	(head)->vtqh_last = &VTAILQ_NEXT((elm), field);			\
} while (0)

#define CHECK_OBJ_NOTNULL(ptr, type_magic)				\ /* <=== include/miniobj.h:42:46:CHECK_OBJ_NOTNULL:2 */ 
	do {								\
		assert((ptr) != NULL);					\
		assert((ptr)->magic == type_magic);			\
	} while (0)

#define assert(e)							\ /* <=== include/vas.h:57:63:assert:1 */ 
do {									\
	if (!(e)) {							\
		VAS_Fail(__func__, __FILE__, __LINE__,			\
		    #e, VAS_ASSERT);					\
	}								\
} while (0)

#define DIGIT(mult, fld)					\ /* <=== lib/libvarnish/vtim.c:177:183:DIGIT:2 */ 
	do {							\
		if (*p < '0' || *p > '9')			\
			FAIL();					\
		fld += (*p - '0') * mult;			\
		p++;						\
	} while(0)

#define INIT_OBJ(to, type_magic)					\ /* <=== include/miniobj.h:14:18:INIT_OBJ:2 */ 
	do {								\
		(void)memset(to, 0, sizeof *(to));			\
		(to)->magic = (type_magic);				\
	} while (0)
void Lck__Unlock(struct lock *lck, const char *p,  int l); /* <=== Lck__Unlock */

#define	VTAILQ_REMOVE(head, elm, field) do {				\ /* <=== include/vqueue.h:545:555:VTAILQ_REMOVE:3 */ 
	if ((VTAILQ_NEXT((elm), field)) != NULL)			\
		VTAILQ_NEXT((elm), field)->field.vtqe_prev =		\
		    (elm)->field.vtqe_prev;				\
	else {								\
		(head)->vtqh_last = (elm)->field.vtqe_prev;		\
	}								\
	*(elm)->field.vtqe_prev = VTAILQ_NEXT((elm), field);		\
	TRASHIT(*oldnext);						\
	TRASHIT(*oldprev);						\
} while (0)

#define MUSTBE(chr)						\ /* <=== lib/libvarnish/vtim.c:185:190:MUSTBE:1 */ 
	do {							\
		if (*p != chr)					\
			FAIL();					\
		p++;						\
	} while(0)

#define	VTAILQ_INIT(head) do {						\ /* <=== include/vqueue.h:497:500:VTAILQ_INIT:1 */ 
	VTAILQ_FIRST((head)) = NULL;					\
	(head)->vtqh_last = &VTAILQ_FIRST((head));			\
} while (0)

#define WEEKDAY()						\ /* <=== lib/libvarnish/vtim.c:192:204:WEEKDAY:0 */ 
	do {							\
		int i;						\
		for (i = 0; i < 7; i++) {			\
			if (!memcmp(p, weekday_name[i], 3)) {	\
				weekday = i;			\
				break;				\
			}					\
		}						\
		if (i == 7)					\
			FAIL();					\
		p += 3;						\
	} while(0)

#define MONTH()							\ /* <=== lib/libvarnish/vtim.c:207:219:MONTH:0 */ 
	do {							\
		int i;						\
		for (i = 0; i < 12; i++) {			\
			if (!memcmp(p, month_name[i], 3)) {	\
				month = i + 1;			\
				break;				\
			}					\
		}						\
		if (i == 12)					\
			FAIL();					\
		p += 3;						\
	} while(0)

#define CHECK_OBJ(ptr, type_magic)					\ /* <=== include/miniobj.h:37:40:CHECK_OBJ:2 */ 
	do {								\
		assert((ptr)->magic == type_magic);			\
	} while (0)

#define Tcheck(t) do {						\ /* <=== bin/varnishd/cache/cache.h:1098:1102:Tcheck:1 */ 
		AN((t).b);					\
		AN((t).e);					\
		assert((t).b <= (t).e);				\
	} while(0)

#define CHECK_OBJ_ORNULL(ptr, type_magic)				\ /* <=== include/miniobj.h:48:52:CHECK_OBJ_ORNULL:2 */ 
	do {								\
		if ((ptr) != NULL)					\
			assert((ptr)->magic == type_magic);		\
	} while (0)

#define	VTAILQ_INSERT_HEAD(head, elm, field) do {			\ /* <=== include/vqueue.h:520:528:VTAILQ_INSERT_HEAD:3 */ 
	if ((VTAILQ_NEXT((elm), field) = VTAILQ_FIRST((head))) != NULL)	\
		VTAILQ_FIRST((head))->field.vtqe_prev =			\
		    &VTAILQ_NEXT((elm), field);				\
	else								\
		(head)->vtqh_last = &VTAILQ_NEXT((elm), field);		\
	VTAILQ_FIRST((head)) = (elm);					\
	(elm)->field.vtqe_prev = &VTAILQ_FIRST((head));			\
} while (0)
